protocol.target: full filtered three-state latent belief, not a marginal or product with an added nuisance factor
protocol.coordinate_interpretation: Trivial: both coordinates action-unnecessary. Reward-State: rho resolves the reward-state partition; delta is the action-irrelevant within-nonreward contrast. Full-State: both can matter for action selection; delta is not a task nuisance there.
protocol.classes: each checkpoint's own greedy action; matched init and controls retain final/source classes and targets
protocol.head_blind: 62-dimensional null space of two logit-difference head rows; each encoder's own head; common logit shift retained
protocol.pooled_r2: 1 - sum(class SSE)/sum(class test-mean-centered SST); class-specific affine refits
protocol.matched_init: initialized transformer replayed on exact final-policy observation/previous-action streams, empty cache per episode, full 1024 steps including warmup; final targets/classes/scored rows retained
protocol.controls: one fixed draw per split; shuffle whole observation/action pairs except reset; random input from separate reset/nonreset empirical pair pools; fit-label permutation within source classes; original targets/classes retained
protocol.bootstrap: 10000 paired whole-test-episode resamples, class means recomputed, probes fixed; conditional on ONE training seed 42 and fixed fit data; 2000 draws for archive checks
protocol.archive_rule: Historical discrepancy threshold max(0.01, 5 * CPU episode-bootstrap SE), now annotations only by user authorization. No archived-parity hard stops. Primary matched comparisons use verified checkpoints and identical CPU histories.
protocol.undefined: constant/empty class R2 null; predictions excluded when class has fewer than two fit rows; counts explicit
protocol.collector_confirmation: PR219 changes only training sampling/likelihoods through exploration_epsilon; greedy argmax and key splitting unchanged; shared probe/models/env/training files unchanged. Local collector is equivalent for greedy probes ignoring temperature and epsilon.

provenance.import_method: git archive from recorded PR219 SHA; only selected transformer arms and recipe/environment sources retained; no merge/rebase
